name: Flatbread with Butternut Squash, Onion, Crispy Sage & Sweet Chili Oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and cut into 3/4-inch cubes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the baking sheet with the squash, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to coat and spread veggies out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until onions are soft and squash is fork-tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, arrange flatbreads on another baking sheet. Add to the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until lightly toasted, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, wash, dry, and pick sage leaves off the stems.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add sage leaves and fry until the leaves stop sizzling and are crispy, about 30 seconds. Using a slotted spoon, remove to a paper towel-lined plate; sprinkle with salt and set aside. Reserve saucepan with oil for the next step.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
0.06 tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add honey and crushed red pepper to the pan with the oil; stir to combine the sweet chili oil. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp honey
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coarsely grate cheese. Layer flatbreads with cheese, roasted squash, and onions.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until flatbreads are golden and cheese is melted, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, slice flatbreads into wedges and arrange on a platter; top with fried sage and drizzle with sweet chili oil. Enjoy!
